Strauss Zelnick’s new interview with Wall Street Journal:

- He knew the GTA 6 delay was a must-have when he was informed by Rockstar’s head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe
- Zelnick was surprised when the interviewer said they don’t have enough hits, noting that they have 15 franchises that have each sold at least 5 million units (RDR2 sold 87M units)
- He values the team’s longevity to ship games together which correlates to long-term success
- Being slavishly devoted to a schedule can lead to disastrous outcomes such pulling a game from the market after release (he’s referring to the Cyberpunk 2077 launch)
- Zelnick emphasized the game is handcrafted without using generative AI
- He finished by saying the game will be spectacularly entertaining
